title: Global Entanglement Quantification via Classical Shadows
summary: Detecting and characterizing quantum correlations are tasks of great relevance in quantum information. More specifically, quantifying the amount of multipartite entanglement is a known difficult task, even for pure states. To this end, several entanglement measures have been proposed, although there is currently no universal manner to do so. In this work, we propose the classical shadows technique to measure the generalized global entanglement introduced in Phys. Rev. A 74, 022314.
